texts.Roberto non aveva ancora capito che il t: Roberto had not yet understood that time was the greatest of mysteries, prison and freedom at once
texts.L'isola giaceva oltre il confine del gio: The island lay beyond the boundary of the day, as unreachable as it was desirable
texts.Il mare era il suo carcere e la sua sper: The sea was his prison and his hope, the only thing that separated him from what he had lost
texts.La notte lo avvolgeva come un mantello d: The night wrapped around him like a cloak of impossible possibilities
texts.Scriveva lettere che non avrebbe mai spe: He wrote letters he would never send, because the recipient was himself in another time
texts.Il corpo ricordava ciò che la mente cerc: The body remembered what the mind tried to forget
